# telnyx_short_code_settings (Resource)

The messaging settings of a short code in your account. Create adopts the short code and assigns it to a messaging profile. Short codes cannot be deleted through the API, so destroy only removes the settings from Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Assign a short code on the account to a messaging profile. Short codes cannot
# be deleted, so destroy only removes the settings from Terraform state.
resource "telnyx_short_code_settings" "alerts" {
  short_code_id        = "a0f9e7b8-1c2d-4e5f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b"
  messaging_profile_id = telnyx_messaging_profile.support.id
  tags                 = ["alerts"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `messaging_profile_id` (String) Unique identifier for a messaging profile.
- `short_code_id` (String) The short code id.

### Optional

- `tags` (Set of String) Tags associated with the resource.

### Read-Only

- `country_code` (String) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Identifies the short code.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `short_code` (String) Short digit sequence used to address messages.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_short_code_settings.alerts <short_code_id>
```
